title: SecurityRuleDocument
description: The persisted form of a named row-authorization rule (design §14.2): the rule expression plus audit and optimistic-concurrency metadata. Backends store this document verbatim.

expression.description: The rule text in the security-rule grammar.

createdBy.description: The actor that created the rule.

lastUpdatedBy.description: The actor that last updated the rule, if any.

lastUpdatedAt.description: When the rule was last updated, if ever.

managementTags.description: The security tags (KVP labels) scoping who may MANAGE this rule (§14.2) — e.g. tenant=acme. Immutable: set at create (the deployment stamps the creator's internal tenant tag; shared infrastructure rules are stamped by the system so they are deployment-global and visible to all), carried forward unchanged on update. Management reads/writes are reach-filtered by these via the caller's AccessContext. Absent on an unscoped (deployment-global) rule.

SecurityTagInfo.title: SecurityTagInfo
SecurityTagInfo.description: A security label (KVP) scoping the rule for row authorization (§14.2).
